implemented: Kite GET route checking uses exact route shapes and validated path components instead of an unsafe prefix-only allowlist.
Instrument route input rejects traversal and malformed exchange codes; embedded query strings, fragments, suffixes, and external URLs are rejected before network access.
Mocked HTTP integration confirms paper-mode read access uses GET only for market-data endpoints and every attempted order route is blocked before transport.
The LIVE_PAPER mode contract explicitly reports that physical orders are disabled.
blockers: Arbitrary caller-injected execution callbacks are outside the provider route guard and still require trusted integration policy.
Owner account/IP allowlisting and live deployment controls are not independently verified.
